feature.headline: Jharkhand High Court: 25 Law Researcher posts open to final-year students
feature.text: The High Court of Jharkhand is hiring 25 Law Researchers / Research Associates at ₹40,000 a month, and final-year LLB students can apply. Applications close on Monday, 28 September 2026, so this is the one to finish this weekend.
points: Open to fresh law graduates, plus 5th-year (5-year LLB) and final-year (3-year LLB) students who pass before joining.
Minimum 60% aggregate; age 21–28; one-year term, extendable to two.
Apply by email with one scanned PDF (10 MB max), as set out in the notification.

sections.title: Judicial Services & Judiciary
sections.short: Civil Judge exams, High Court research posts
sections.intro: Judge-track openings and court research roles. Under Bhumika Trust v. Union of India (21 Aug 2026), fresh graduates can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) until 31 March 2027; no state has opened a new fresher-eligible notification this week.

items.name: Law Researcher / Research Associate
items.org: High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi · Advt. No. 01/Recruitment Cell/2026
items.eligibility: Fresh law graduates and postgraduates; final-year students may apply if they pass before joining. Minimum 60%, age 21–28.
items.note: Apply by email: one PDF of scanned documents, 10 MB max, sent to the address given in the notification.

items.name: Civil Judge (Junior Division): Odisha Judicial Service
items.eligibility: LLB; Odia language proficiency. Under the Supreme Court's August 2026 ruling, fresh graduates are now eligible during the transition period.

facts.v: Closing date extended until further notice

items.note: OPSC put the closing date and the prelims on hold after the Supreme Court's order in Bhumika Trust; no new dates were posted this week. Watch the OPSC site.

sections.title: Government Legal Jobs & Internships
sections.intro: Government roles and internships open to students and new graduates. Posts that need years at the Bar are listed separately below.

items.name: Internship Programme, Oct–Dec 2026
items.org: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), New Delhi
items.eligibility: Law students at bachelor's or master's level. Internships run 2 to 6 months.
items.note: Earlier applicants must apply again. Shortlisted candidates may be asked for a write-up or presentation.

items.name: Legal Assistant, High Court Legal Services Committee
items.org: High Court of Meghalaya, Shillong · Advt. No. HCM.II/I09/2020-Rect/54
items.eligibility: LLB; legal-aid experience is preferred, not required. Age up to 32 (SC/ST 37).
items.note: Apply online only through the High Court's website; the work covers legal aid applications and coordination with DLSAs and panel lawyers.

items.name: NITI Aayog Internship
items.org: NITI Aayog, Government of India, New Delhi
items.eligibility: Enrolled UG or PG students, including LLB students.
items.note: The online form is open only from the 1st to the 10th of each month; read the guidelines on the official page before applying.

also.title: Also open, but they need practice experience

list.text: UPSC Advt. 11/2026: Assistant Public Prosecutor, Delhi, 140 posts (3 years at the Bar), closes 2 Oct 2026; Law Officer, UT of Ladakh, 4 posts (2 years' practice), closes 9 Oct 2026
OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor (Advt. 09 of 2026-27), 172 posts: 2 years' practice; a 2nd corrigendum was issued on 22 Sep, check it for current dates
Central Railway, Railway Advocates, 33 posts: 3 years' practice, closes 23 Oct 2026
NALSA Assistant (Legal) and Assistant Legal Aid Advisor: 1–3 years' experience, closes 10 Oct 2026

sections.title: Exams & Entrance Tests
sections.short: AIBE, UGC NET and other qualifying exams
sections.intro: Qualifying and eligibility exams. LLM entrance tests (CLAT PG, AILET) are on the LLM Admissions page.

items.name: All India Bar Examination XXII
items.eligibility: LLB graduates, and final-semester LLB students with no backlogs. You need this to practise law.

items.name: UGC NET, December 2026 (Law)
items.eligibility: For LLM students and graduates (a master's degree is required; final-year LLM students may apply). Leads to Assistant Professor posts and the JRF.
items.note: The registration notice for the December 2026 cycle is not yet on the NTA portal. Keep this on your list if you plan an LLM.

sections.title: LLM Admissions: NLUs & Maharashtra
sections.short: NLUs, state universities and private colleges in Maharashtra
sections.intro: Where you can apply for an LLM starting in 2027. NLU seats are open now through CLAT PG and AILET; Maharashtra's state and private colleges have not yet published 2027–28 notices, so they are tracked here until they do.

items.name: LLM at NLUs through CLAT 2027 (PG)
items.eligibility: LLB graduates; final-year students may apply. One score covers LLM seats at the consortium NLUs, including MNLU Mumbai, Nagpur and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.
items.note: Many PSUs also recruit law officers on CLAT PG scores, so this score does double duty.

items.name: LLM at NLU Delhi through AILET 2027
items.eligibility: Passed or in the final year of a 3-year or 5-year LLB.

items.name: LL.M. at University of Mumbai (LL.M. CET)
items.org: University of Mumbai, Department of Law and affiliated colleges
items.eligibility: LLB graduates; admission is through the university's own LL.M. CET.
items.note: The university usually runs its LL.M. CET in the first half of the year. Watch the university's admissions notices.

items.name: LL.M. at Symbiosis Law School, Pune
items.eligibility: 3-year or 5-year LLB with 50%. Selection through Symbiosis AIAT (written test plus personal interview).
items.note: The official page still shows last cycle's dates; last year's window opened in September, so check it often.

items.name: LL.M. at NMIMS Kirit P. Mehta School of Law, Mumbai
items.eligibility: LLB with 50%; final-year students may apply. Admission through the NMIMS test or a CLAT PG score, plus an interview.
items.note: The official portal still shows the 2026 cycle.

sections.title: Private Jobs, Fellowships & Internships
sections.short: Research fellowships, policy fellowships, firm portals
sections.intro: Fellowships and private openings, taken only from the organisation's own website. Big firms rarely post fresher roles publicly, so their official application portals are listed below.

items.name: Graduate Research Fellowship 2027
items.org: National Law School of India University, Bengaluru
items.eligibility: Open to scholars in law, policy and the social sciences. NLSIU does not state a minimum qualification, so read the call before applying.
items.note: On campus in Bengaluru. Apply through the form linked in the official call.

items.name: LAMP Fellowship 2027–28
items.org: PRS Legislative Research, New Delhi · private
items.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 25 or below with a bachelor's degree in any field; you work with a Member of Parliament for a year.
items.note: Applications for 2026–27 are closed. Check the official page for the 2027–28 call.
